name: Presidency of Kenya
notes: The President is head of state and government; not a chamber, so no seat chart.

name: National Assembly of Kenya
notes: 349 members: 290 constituency seats, 47 county women representatives and 12 nominated by parties. No Seats chart: Parliament's member page lists names and parties but the party breakdown of the 13th Parliament is only a PDF, and the figures found elsewhere (Wikipedia tables, press) disagree with each other after many defections and floor-crossings, so no reliable count by party is published in machine-readable form. No supporter sits.

name: Senate of Kenya
notes: 67 seats: 47 county senators, 16 women nominated by parties, 2 youth and 2 persons with disabilities. No Seats chart: no official party count was found and the nominated seats are filled by party list. No supporter sits.
